LanguageData.Luke_ImplantSalvageSettingsMaxDestroyDes: The chance of wrecking an implant when the surgeon has no medical ability at all. Skill scales the real chance down from here.
LanguageData.Luke_ImplantSalvageSettingsMinDestroyDes: The floor no amount of skill can go below, mirroring vanilla surgery always carrying some risk. Set to 0% to make expert extraction perfectly safe.
LanguageData.Luke_ImplantSalvageSettingsShowChance: Show the intact chance in the right-click menu
LanguageData.Luke_ImplantSalvageSettingsShowMarker: Mark corpses that hold a salvageable implant
LanguageData.Luke_ImplantSalvageSettingsShowMarkerDes: Draws the implant's own icon over any corpse still carrying one, so you can see which bodies are worth a doctor's time without right-clicking each one. Off by default. Only implants ticked in the list below are marked.
LanguageData.Luke_ImplantSalvageSettingsImplantListDe: Untick anything you would rather not be told about - say, prosthetic legs while keeping bionic legs. This controls the corpse marker and the storage and bill filters; the right-click menu always offers everything, so you can still take an unticked implant by hand. Implants added by other mods appear here automatically and start ticked.
